releases.displayName: Way of the Hunter – Community Update

items.text: Hello Hunters,

As many of you know, Way of the Hunter 2 recently entered Early Access. It’s been quite a ride so far — as with any game launch, there were a few hiccups along the way — but overall the response from you, the players, has been incredibly positive and motivating for the entire team. Thank you for that. It truly means a lot to us.

Over the past couple of months, our focus has been almost entirely on getting the sequel ready and supporting it through its Early Access launch. That said, we want to reassure you that we have not forgotten about the first game or the community that helped it grow into what it is today.

You may have noticed a small update downloading for Way of the Hunter. This was only a minor asset change in the main menu to update the Way of the Hunter 2 banner window with the current information. Even though we have been very busy lately, rest assured that we have also been monitoring issues in the first game.

Several players have encountered bugs that we still plan to revisit and continue investigating. This includes the so-called “fitness bug,” which we are fully aware of and have been tracking internally. While we cannot yet provide a clear timeline for when this issue will be resolved, it remains on our list of priorities that we intend to address first.
If you run into an issue in Way of the Hunter and haven’t reported it yet, please do so via the THQ Nordic Redmine, to help us track and investigate the problem.

Also, if you haven’t already, be sure to check out Way of the Hunter 2 in Early Access. There’s currently a launch sale, which makes this a great opportunity to jump in at a lower price, experience the game as it evolves, and have a real say in shaping its future updates and features.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543830/Way_of_the_Hunter_2/"]
Thank you again for your patience, your feedback, and your continued support! We’re grateful to have such a passionate hunting community alongside us.
Happy hunting!

THQ Nordic and Nine Rocks Games are excited to announce Elkcrest Island, the fifth and final map DLC for Way of the Hunter, and for the first time ever, it is completely free. Serving as a heartfelt thank you to the dedicated players and community who have supported the game over the past 3.5 years, Elkcrest Island marks a celebratory close to the Way of the Hunter journey before the studio turns its full focus to the next title in the franchise. At the same time, players can look ahead: the Steam page for the upcoming project goes live today, allowing fans to begin adding the game to their wishlists. While the final name is still in discussion, this marks the official start of the next chapter for the development team.

Update 1.31 is now live, and it brings Elkcrest Island, a remote northern wilderness, rich with North America's most iconic game species. This isolated, sparsely populated landscape also debuts a new predator in the franchise: the North American cougar! And the most requested animal is making a comeback: Merriam’s wild turkey.

Players can explore dramatic hills and mountain ranges to scout major big game, from moose and elk to Bighorn sheep, caribou, Sitka deer, Wood bison, and the imposing Kodiak bear. Those seeking variety can head to serene lakes and open plains, home to wild ducks, surf scoters, pheasants, and lesser scaup. Predators like the Gray wolf and Red fox roam the terrain, while patient hunters may even spot the swift snowshoe hare.Preview Event

Alongside the free DLC map Elkcrest Island, update 1.31 is now live on all platforms. This update also brings the North American cougar to Nez Perce Valley, Aurora Shores, and Elkcrest Island - harvest one or explore its need zones to unlock more info in the in-game encyclopedia. Alongside the new content, update 1.31 fixes essential issues and provides compensation for players affected by the previous update 1.29.1 before the hotfix. Let’s take a closer look.
Update 1.31 also brings several fixes and includes compensation for earlier update issues.
All players receive compensation for the inconvenience caused by the update 1.29.1. Since some players lost a rare-fur trophy, we’re adding a guaranteed high-fitness rare-fur animal to every reserve:
Nez Perce Valley: Melanistic Mule Deer - Private/Lowland
Transylvania: Albino Red Deer - Private/Lowland
Aurora Shores: Melanistic Alaska Moose - Primary/Grassland
Tikamoon Plains: Albino Cape Buffalo - Private/Savanna
Matariki Park: Albino White-Tailed Deer - Private/Lowland
Lintukoto Reserve: Melanistic Fallow Deer - Private/Highland Forest

If your save file was impacted and you loaded the game before the hotfix was available, this update will apply a herd-management recovery boost. The game will identify weaker animals in affected habitats and increase their fitness by 50% toward the habitat’s gene-pool maximum, which means a small boost to those, who have lost their herd management progress. As part of this process, the game will automatically trigger a new in-game year the first time you load in after the update, but only for those affected saves.
Some herd management stats that previously failed to load correctly should self-correct over the next two in-game years.

With Update 1.30, Way of the Hunter welcomes a new addition to its lineup of authentic, real-world firearm brands. Authenticity matters in our game, and bringing real, trusted brands into the game is a key part of that experience. We’re proud to welcome STRASSER, recognised for reliable, well-crafted rifles. For decades, the STRASSER family business has been manufacturing essential components for hunting and sporting firearms for world-renowned brands. Parts produced at STRASSER’s facility in Eugendorf, near Salzburg, Austria, have even accompanied the European space rocket Ariane into space.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4071730/Way_of_the_Hunter__Strasser_Pack/"]
But above all, the Strassers and their gunsmiths are passionate hunters and have their fingers on the pulse of the industry.

STRASSER has set an important milestone and in the history of hunting rifles with the trend-setting straight pull system. The safe and accurate design and ergonomic operating functions make STRASSER straight-pull rifles a reliable companion for hunters and sports marksmen. It’s on these strong foundations that the STRASSER legacy is built.

Hi hunters,

After Update 1.29.1 went live, many of you reported issues that needed our immediate attention. Some players experienced certain herds losing their genetic potential after loading a save, with a few habitats affected more heavily than others. For those impacted — we’re genuinely sorry.

The addition of turkeys in 1.29.1 unexpectedly put pressure on parts of the herd-management logic, which caused some herds to break and trigger resets. That one’s on us, and we’re truly sorry for the frustration it caused. Over the past two days, we’ve been digging into the issue, and the hotfix for Update 1.29.1 is now available on PC.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/afbac8b33c8edddb3f377799286d83c94d20669c.jpg"]
Corrects the English name for Merriam’s turkey (other localizations will be fixed in an upcoming update).
Resolves an issue where Mule deer near the lodge could spawn in unusually high numbers.
Stops the herd-genetics reset from happening going forward.
Protects save files for anyone who had not loaded the game after Update 1.29.1. If you backed up your save or hadn’t launched the game yet, your herds should remain intact.
We want you to know that we’re still actively investigating the issue. Today’s hotfix focuses on preventing any further progression loss while we continue looking into the issue.
Fixed: An issue where certain herds would lose their genetic potential after loading a game.
Fixed: Mule deer near the lodge spawning in unusually large herd sizes.
Fixed: The turkey’s subspecies incorrect name in English localization (more localizations are on the way).
We will be grateful for any and all feedback and bug reports via THQ Nordic Redmine. When creating a ticket, please make sure that you enter the correct version of the game.

notes.title: Christensen Arms Joins Way of the Hunter With Two New Rifles!

items.text: THQ Nordic and Nine Rocks Games proudly announce the latest collaboration between Way of the Hunter and Christensen Arms, the innovative firearm manufacturer based in Gunnison, Utah. This partnership introduces two of Christensen Arms’ most celebrated hunting rifles to the game, offering players an authentic and premium shooting experience. Both rifles are available now in Way of the Hunter, bringing Christensen Arms’ signature performance and innovation to virtual hunting enthusiasts worldwide.
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/fm79N-u_LAA?si=Lr7hHqgycyMYCz30"]

Founded in 1995 by world-class mechanical engineer Roland Christensen, Christensen Arms revolutionized the industry by using patented aerospace technology to create the world’s first carbon fiber rifle barrel. Nearly three decades later, the company continues to set new standards for lightweight, precision-engineered firearms that blend innovation, performance, and craftsmanship.
Modern Hunting Rifle

Tradition Redefined Crafted for the modern hunter who values both form and function, the Modern Hunting Rifle (MHR) blends cutting-edge technology with classic design. Built upon an aluminium mini chassis with V-block bedding, it delivers the accuracy potential of a chassis rifle while retaining the ergonomics of a traditional hunting firearm. Whether pursuing game in the wild or hitting targets at the range, the MHR provides a perfect balance of innovation, performance, and timeless appeal.
Caliber: 7mm Rem Mag
Modern Precision Rifle

Precision Without Compromise Born from tactical roots and built for real-world performance, the Modern Precision Rifle (MPR) is the ultimate crossover rifle. Its folding, adjustable chassis and free-floating carbon fiber barrel provide exceptional stability and precision in any environment. Threaded and suppressor-ready, with a full-length M-LOK handguard, the MPR is engineered for accuracy, whether striking steel at 1,000 yards or tracking elk at 400.
Caliber: .338 Lapua Magnum
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290615/db50e92096bed5b7cecb2cb419472f79860e668c.png"]

The Common eland has arrived in Tikamoon Plains – a true giant among antelopes and a worthy challenge for any hunter. Strong, resilient, and majestic, the eland will put your tracking and shooting skills to the test. This update also brings a range of gameplay improvements and refinements. Aiming now feels smoother thanks to reduced blur on iron sights, and the zeroing for the Prairie Hunter the Jack iron sight has been adjusted to 50 meters for more accurate shots. We’ve also refreshed the audio experience with updated sound effects for the Steyr-Gams rifle and several rifles from the Hunter’s Advantage Pack.

The electronic caller delay has been resolved, its UI now updates correctly, and the hunter sense dot alignment on the Prairie Hunter the Jack has been corrected. We’ve also smoothed out some localization issues and minor environmental glitches, like the levitating grass on Nez Perce Valley. For more details, please check the patch notes below.

Update 1.27.1 is now live, bringing a free Integrix® iX6 scope, improved headlamp visibility, and visual fixes for a smoother, more immersive hunt.

We’re proud to welcome Integrix® to Way of the Hunter! Known for their commitment to precision, clarity, and craftsmanship, this proud optics brand is now officially a part of the in-game gear lineup, with their iX6 3-18x44 scope available free for all players. Designed for mid-to-long range shooting and low-light conditions, this premium scope delivers next-level accuracy for those who demand precision in every shot.

While this may be a more focused update, it brings meaningful improvements that enhance how you see and play. Alongside the addition of the Integrix scope, the headlamp has been upgraded with doubled range, offering better visibility during nighttime hunts. A visual issue with grass pop-in has also been resolved to maintain immersion across natural environments. Additionally, based on player feedback, we've adjusted the reticule thickness on the Overgaard Night Stalker 5–15x and Overgaard Night Stalker 3-9x scopes for better usability and visual clarity.
Take the shot with confidence - Integrix has officially joined the hunt.
Free Rifle Scope: Integrix iX6 3-18x44

notes.title: What’s in the Night Hunting Pack DLC

items.text: Overgaard Night Hawk 4-16x Binoculars Designed for serious hunters who demand reliable gear, these high-quality night vision binoculars feature a 4–16x magnification range. With crisp black-and-white night vision, they help you identify movement and terrain detail even in challenging light conditions.

Overgaard Night Stalker 5-15x Rifle Scope An adaptable digital riflescope tailored for medium to long-range use. Built for precision in pitch-black environments, it delivers a clear visual with variable magnification. Its high-resolution sensor gives you the advantage when lining up shots during late-night hunts.

ZOOMXD Blackout-NV Collimator A close-range digital collimator built for instinctive aiming and situational awareness in low-light scenarios. While compact and fast to deploy, it offers fixed magnification and a clean digital overlay. Ideal for close-quarters hunts where reaction time is critical.

ZOOMXD ShadowView 1-5x Crossbow Scope Crafted for crossbow hunters, this scope excels in low-light conditions - from deep woods to the twilight edge. With a 25mm objective lens for precise targeting, it’s built to keep you accurate when visibility is at its worst.

This free night vision scope is available to all players via in-game money from the in-game store. Lightweight, versatile, and perfect for entry-level night hunts.
Reworked HUD Customization
You asked, we delivered! The HUD system now features four global presets and complete control over individual elements:
Fully Visible: Everything is always on screen.
Dynamic: HUD elements appear during interactions and fade out after 4 seconds (with an exception to Tutorials and Mission Information HUD elements).
Immersive: No HUD at all for complete immersion.
Custom: Fine-tune each HUD element separately to your liking.

When you start adjusting individual elements, your global preset will automatically switch to "Custom" so you can create your perfect setup. Note: This update resets your HUD elements to default (Fully Visible). If you set the Mission Information to your custom preset and turn it OFF, you can still toggle its visibility at any time using the “O” key.
For new players, once you’ve completed the tutorial missions in Nez Perce Valley, you’ll have full access to customize the HUD elements to fit your playstyle.

Update 1.26.7 brings several key improvements to Way of the Hunter. PC players can now enjoy FSR2 and DLSS presets for better visual quality and performance. Multiplayer features a location ping system, join and leave notifications, and an upgraded server browser with map details and difficulty levels.

We’ve also improved the herd management info on the hunting map, made the encyclopedia more user-friendly, and refined HUDless mode for a more immersive experience. Additionally, we’ve fixed several bugs, including shotgun reload issues, audio glitches, and floating trees in Transylvania - for more details, please check the patch notes below.

With this update, we're introducing an enhanced Hunting Map UI, providing clearer insights into animal herds, their habitats, and the impact of your hunting activities. This update makes herd management more accessible by allowing players to track herd fitness over time and see how their hunting choices affect populations. Previously, manual note-taking was required, but now, after each in-game year, you can easily view herd fitness levels on the map, helping to refine your strategy for more effective and sustainable management. For detailed info on this feature, we’ve prepared a full breakdown HERE.

Firearms energy rebalance:
Hit energy of every firearm has been increased
Rate of energy loss decreases with increasing shot distance (firearms will be noticeably more powerful on long-distance shots)

Since this was a highly requested change and it affects every firearm in the game, we would like to give you a bit more detail on what the goal of this rebalance is.

Though you can view it as an across-the-board buff, the energy increase varies for each firearm, and it is especially pronounced with long-range shots. Real-life bullets do not lose less energy the longer they travel, but we believe this to be the best solution for the widest variety of in-game hunts. Overall, the firearms should now feel more authentic to their real-life counterparts and they should prove to be more lethal, although you will still need place your shots carefully.

To illustrate, we have prepared a performance comparison of a handful of the most popular rifles. Below, you can check out the hit energy of these rifles at 200/500/800m: 1. before the introduction of ammo change, 2. in the last previous version of the game, and 3. now.

items.text: Clothes Make The Hunter: New Outfits DLC and Update For Way of The Hunter

Bratislava, Slovakia / Vienna, Austria - May 16, 2024: Time to hunt in style - the new Outfits Pack DLC is available now. Explore the wilderness in the attire of a traditional Slovak hunter or a distinguished gentleman! The DLC includes one original costume for each character - River, April, Wallace, Jackie, and Malachi, all usable in Free Hunt and Multiplayer mode.
The Outfits Pack Teaser on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_ur71x-IWXQ

Along with the Outfits Pack, on May 16th, a new patch for Way of the Hunter will be released on all platforms, introducing numerous tweaks, improvements, and fixes to the game. Anticipate enhanced controller support on PC, several new parking spots scattered throughout Nez Perce Valley and Transylvania, and more.
Check the full patch notes here: https://thqnordic.com/article/way-hunter-patch-1252

The Outfits Pack DLC is available now for an SRP of € 4.99 / $ 4.99. Owners of Map Pack 2 will receive the Outfits Pack DLC on launch day free of charge! The base game is required to play the DLC. Way of the Hunter is available for PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S at an SRP of $ 39.99 / € 39.99.
Way of the Hunter - Map Pack 2

The Way of the Hunter Map Pack 2 includes two new region DLCs. Each new map is 64 square kilometers / 25 square miles and comes with new wildlife, story and features. The first new region has already been released: Matariki Park lets you explore New Zealand with a brand new story, many new animal species, and a premium portable stand. The second new region DLC will be released in Summer 2024.
Website: http://wayofthehunter.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/wayofthehunter
Enjoy & stay tuned!
